name: llmlint-mock-oneharness
//: The mock-oneharness fixture: the oneharness wire double behind llmlint's --oneharness-bin seam. Its Cargo dependency on the llmlint crate (for MIN_VERSION) is the implicit dependency below; every Cargo path edge is mirrored as an Nx edge (tools/check-project-boundaries.mjs checks it). No tests of its own: the e2e journeys are what exercise it.

build.//: Produces target/debug/llmlint-mock-oneharness, the fixture the e2e journeys put behind --oneharness-bin when they run uninstrumented; under coverage they drive the copy tools/coverage/coverage.sh builds.
